versos.grego: Οὐ θέλω γὰρ ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν, ἀδελφοί, ὅτι οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν πάντες ὑπὸ τὴν νεφέλην ἦσαν καὶ πάντες διὰ τῆς θαλάσσης διῆλθον,

controles.web: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
controles.kjv: Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
controles.livre: Ora, irmãos, eu não quero que ignoreis que todos os nossos pais estiveram debaixo da nuvem, e todos pelo mar passaram;

versos.grego: καὶ πάντες εἰς τὸν Μωϋσῆν ἐβαπτίσαντο ἐν τῇ νεφέλῃ καὶ ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ,

controles.web: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
controles.kjv: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
controles.livre: E todos foram batizados na nuvem e no mar em Moisés;

versos.grego: καὶ πάντες τὸ αὐτὸ πνευματικὸν βρῶμα ἔφαγον,

controles.web: and all ate the same spiritual food;
controles.kjv: And did all eat the same spiritual meat;
controles.livre: E todos comeram de um mesmo alimento espiritual;

versos.grego: καὶ πάντες τὸ αὐτὸ πνευματικὸν ἔπιον πόμα· ἔπινον γὰρ ἐκ πνευματικῆς ἀκολουθούσης πέτρας, ἡ πέτρα δὲ ἦν ὁ Χριστός,

controles.web: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.
controles.kjv: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.
controles.livre: E todos beberam de uma mesma bebida espiritual; porque bebiam da pedra espiritual que os seguia; e a pedra era Cristo.

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἐν τοῖς πλείοσιν αὐτῶν εὐδόκησεν ὁ Θεός· κατεστρώθησαν γὰρ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ.

controles.web: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
controles.kjv: But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
controles.livre: Mas da maioria deles Deus não se agradou; por isso foram deixados no deserto.

versos.grego: Ταῦτα δὲ τύποι ἡμῶν ἐγενήθησαν, εἰς τὸ μὴ εἶναι ἡμᾶς ἐπιθυμητὰς κακῶν, καθὼς κἀκεῖνοι ἐπεθύμησαν.

controles.web: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.
controles.kjv: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.
controles.livre: E estas coisas nos servem de exemplos, para que não desejemos coisas ruins, como eles desejaram.

versos.grego: μηδὲ εἰδωλολάτραι γίνεσθε, καθώς τινες αὐτῶν· ὥσπερ γέγραπται Ἐκάθισεν ὁ λαὸς φαγεῖν καὶ πεῖν, καὶ ἀνέστησαν παίζειν.

controles.web: Neither be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”
controles.kjv: Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
controles.livre: E não sejais idólatras, como alguns deles foram ,como está escrito: O povo se sentou para comer, e para beber, e levantaram-se para se alegrarem.

versos.grego: μηδὲ πορνεύωμεν, καθώς τινες αὐτῶν ἐπόρνευσαν, καὶ ἔπεσαν μιᾷ ἡμέρᾳ εἰκοσιτρεῖς χιλιάδες.

controles.web: Neither let us commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.
controles.kjv: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.
controles.livre: E não pequemos sexualmente, como alguns deles assim pecaram, e em um dia vinte e três mil caíram.

versos.grego: μηδὲ ἐκπειράζωμεν τὸν Κύριον, καθώς τινες αὐτῶν ἐπείρασαν καὶ ὑπὸ τῶν ὄφεων ἀπώλλυντο.

controles.web: Neither let us test the Lord, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.
controles.kjv: Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.
controles.livre: E não tentemos a Cristo, como também alguns deles tentaram, e pereceram pelas serpentes.

versos.grego: μηδὲ γογγύζετε, καθάπερ τινὲς αὐτῶν ἐγόγγυσαν, καὶ ἀπώλοντο ὑπὸ τοῦ ὀλοθρευτοῦ.

controles.web: Neither grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.
controles.kjv: Neither murmur ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.
controles.livre: E não murmureis, como também alguns deles murmuraram, e pereceram pelo destruidor.

versos.grego: ταῦτα δὲ τυπικῶς συνέβαινεν ἐκείνοις, ἐγράφη δὲ πρὸς νουθεσίαν ἡμῶν, εἰς οὓς τὰ τέλη τῶν αἰώνων κατήντηκεν.

controles.web: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.
controles.kjv: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.
controles.livre: E todas estas coisas lhes aconteceram como exemplos, e estão escritas para nosso aviso, em quem os fins dos tempos têm chegado.

versos.grego: Ὥστε ὁ δοκῶν ἑστάναι βλεπέτω μὴ πέσῃ,

controles.web: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.
controles.kjv: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
controles.livre: Portanto, aquele que pensa estar de pé, olhe para que não caia.

versos.grego: πειρασμὸς ὑμᾶς οὐκ εἴληφεν εἰ μὴ ἀνθρώπινος· πιστὸς δὲ ὁ Θεός, ὃς οὐκ ἐάσει ὑμᾶς πειρασθῆναι ὑπὲρ ὃ δύνασθε, ἀλλὰ ποιήσει σὺν τῷ πειρασμῷ καὶ τὴν ἔκβασιν τοῦ δύνασθαι ὑπενεγκεῖν.

controles.web: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
controles.kjv: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
controles.livre: Nenhuma tentação vos veio, que não fosse humana; porém Deus é fiel; que não vos deixará tentar mais do que o que podeis, antes com a tentação também dará a saída, para que a possais suportar.

versos.grego: Διόπερ, ἀγαπητοί μου, φεύγετε ἀπὸ τῆς εἰδωλολατρείας.

controles.web: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
controles.kjv: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.
controles.livre: Portanto, meus amados, fugi da idolatria.

versos.grego: ὡς φρονίμοις λέγω· κρίνατε ὑμεῖς ὅ φημι.

controles.web: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.
controles.kjv: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.
controles.livre: Eu vos falo como que para prudentes; jugai vós mesmos o que eu digo.

versos.grego: Τὸ ποτήριον τῆς εὐλογίας ὃ εὐλογοῦμεν, οὐχὶ κοινωνία ἐστὶν τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ; τὸν ἄρτον ὃν κλῶμεν, οὐχὶ κοινωνία τοῦ σώματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐστιν;

controles.web: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?
controles.kjv: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?
controles.livre: Por acaso o copo da bênção, que nós bendizemos, não é a comunhão do sangue de Cristo? O pão que partimos, não é a comunhão do corpo de Cristo?

versos.grego: ὅτι εἷς ἄρτος, ἓν σῶμα οἱ πολλοί ἐσμεν· οἱ γὰρ πάντες ἐκ τοῦ ἑνὸς ἄρτου μετέχομεν.

controles.web: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.
controles.kjv: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.
controles.livre: Porque assim como há um só pão, nós muitos somos um só corpo; porque todos participamos de um só pão.

versos.grego: βλέπετε τὸν Ἰσραὴλ κατὰ σάρκα· οὐχ οἱ ἐσθίοντες τὰς θυσίας κοινωνοὶ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου εἰσίν;

controles.web: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?
controles.kjv: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?
controles.livre: Vede a Israel segundo a carne: por acaso os que comem os sacrifícios não são participantes do altar?

versos.grego: τί οὖν φημι; ὅτι εἰδωλόθυτόν τί ἐστιν; ἢ ὅτι εἴδωλόν τί ἐστιν;

controles.web: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?
controles.kjv: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?
controles.livre: Então o que eu digo? Que o ídolo é alguma coisa? Ou que o sacrifício ao ídolo seja alguma coisa?

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ ὅτι ἃ θύουσιν, δαιμονίοις καὶ οὐ Θεῷ θύουσιν· οὐ θέλω δὲ ὑμᾶς κοινωνοὺς τῶν δαιμονίων γίνεσθαι.

controles.web: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons, and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.
controles.kjv: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.
controles.livre: Mas eu digo, que as coisas que os gentios sacrificam, são sacrificadas para os demônios, e não a Deus. E não quero que sejais participantes dos demônios.

versos.grego: οὐ δύνασθε ποτήριον Κυρίου πίνειν καὶ ποτήριον δαιμονίων· οὐ δύνασθε τραπέζης Κυρίου μετέχειν καὶ τραπέζης δαιμονίων.

controles.web: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord, and of the table of demons.
controles.kjv: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord’s table, and of the table of devils.
controles.livre: Não podeis beber o copo do Senhor e o copo dos demônios; não podeis ser participantes da mesa do Senhor e da mesa dos demônios.

versos.grego: ἢ παραζηλοῦμεν τὸν Κύριον; μὴ ἰσχυρότεροι αὐτοῦ ἐσμεν;

controles.web: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?
controles.kjv: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
controles.livre: Tentamos provocar ciúmes ao Senhor? Somos nós mais fortes que ele?

versos.grego: Πάντα ἔξεστιν, ἀλλ’ οὐ πάντα συμφέρει. πάντα ἔξεστιν, ἀλλ’ οὐ πάντα οἰκοδομεῖ.

controles.web: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.
controles.kjv: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.
controles.livre: Todas as coisas me são lícitas, mas nem todas as coisas convêm; todas as coisas me são licitas, mas nem todas as coisas edificam.

versos.grego: μηδεὶς τὸ ἑαυτοῦ ζητείτω ἀλλὰ τὸ τοῦ ἑτέρου.

controles.web: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.
controles.kjv: Let no man seek his own, but every man another’s wealth.
controles.livre: Ninguém busque para si próprio, antes cada um busque o bem do outro.

versos.grego: Πᾶν τὸ ἐν μακέλλῳ πωλούμενον ἐσθίετε μηδὲν ἀνακρίνοντες διὰ τὴν συνείδησιν·

controles.web: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,
controles.kjv: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:
controles.livre: De tudo o que se vende no açougue, comei, sem vos questionar por causa da consciência.

versos.grego: τοῦ Κυρίου γὰρ ἡ γῆ καὶ τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῆς.

controles.web: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”
controles.kjv: For the earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof.
controles.livre: Porque a terra é do Senhor, e também sua plenitude.

versos.grego: εἴ τις καλεῖ ὑμᾶς τῶν ἀπίστων καὶ θέλετε πορεύεσθαι, πᾶν τὸ παρατιθέμενον ὑμῖν ἐσθίετε μηδὲν ἀνακρίνοντες διὰ τὴν συνείδησιν.

controles.web: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.
controles.kjv: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.
controles.livre: E se alguém dos descrentes vos convidar, e quiserdes ir, comei de tudo o que for posto diante de vós, sem vos questionar por causa da consciência.

versos.grego: ἐὰν δέ τις ὑμῖν εἴπῃ Τοῦτο ἱερόθυτόν ἐστιν, μὴ ἐσθίετε δι’ ἐκεῖνον τὸν μηνύσαντα καὶ τὴν συνείδησιν·

controles.web: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, and all its fullness.”
controles.kjv: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof:
controles.livre: Mas se alguém vos disser: “Isto é sacrifício a ídolos”, não comais, por causa daquele que vos advertiu, e por causa da consciência. Porque a terra e sua plenitude pertencem ao Senhor.

versos.grego: συνείδησιν δὲ λέγω οὐχὶ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ἀλλὰ τὴν τοῦ ἑτέρου. ἵνα τί γὰρ ἡ ἐλευθερία μου κρίνεται ὑπὸ ἄλλης συνειδήσεως;

controles.web: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?
controles.kjv: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man’s conscience?
controles.livre: Mas digo da consciência do outro, não a tua. Por que, então, minha liberdade é julgada pela consciência do outro?

versos.grego: εἰ ἐγὼ χάριτι μετέχω, τί βλασφημοῦμαι ὑπὲρ οὗ ἐγὼ εὐχαριστῶ;

controles.web: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for that for which I give thanks?
controles.kjv: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
controles.livre: E se eu participo da comida pela graça, por que sou ofendido naquilo que dou graças?

versos.grego: Εἴτε οὖν ἐσθίετε εἴτε πίνετε εἴτε τι ποιεῖτε, πάντα εἰς δόξαν Θεοῦ ποιεῖτε.

controles.web: Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
controles.kjv: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
controles.livre: Portanto, ao comer, ou ao beber, ou ao fazer qualquer coisa, fazei tudo para a glória de Deus.

versos.grego: ἀπρόσκοποι καὶ Ἰουδαίοις γίνεσθε καὶ Ἕλλησιν καὶ τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ,

controles.web: Give no occasions for stumbling, either to Jews, or to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;
controles.kjv: Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God:
controles.livre: Sede sem escândalo, nem a judeus, nem a gregos, nem à Igreja de Deus.

versos.grego: καθὼς κἀγὼ πάντα πᾶσιν ἀρέσκω, μὴ ζητῶν τὸ ἐμαυτοῦ σύμφορον ἀλλὰ τὸ τῶν πολλῶν, ἵνα σωθῶσιν.

controles.web: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.
controles.kjv: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.
controles.livre: Assim como eu também agrado a todos em tudo, não buscando meu próprio proveito, mas sim o de muitos, para que assim possam se salvar.
